cases.input: Half-time engagement with contractedCapacityFraction 0.5 against a declared FTE basis, two concurrent assignments at 0.25 each, no ordinary absence, Europe/Athens, tzdbRelease and calendarRuleSetRelease pinned in the manifest.
cases.expect: plannedAvailability is computed as pattern intersected with calendar working time minus approved ordinary absence; allocationResidual is published as 0.0; no worklog is read.

cases.input: contractedCapacityFraction 0.5 with concurrent allocations 0.25 and 0.35; the projection publishes residualFraction -0.10.
cases.expect: The projection is rejected; a negative residualFraction is never published.
residualFraction 0 is published with an overcommitment finding carrying excessFraction 0.10; both source assignments, the absence set and every worklog remain unchanged.

cases.input: Residual capacity is recomputed by subtracting the exact elapsed duration of the period's worklogs from plannedAvailability.
cases.expect: The computation is rejected; worklogs are not inputs to availability or residual.

cases.input: Two worklogs on different charge targets overlap by one clock hour; both elapsed durations are summed and charged against contracted capacity.
cases.expect: The computation is rejected; the overlapping clock interval is counted once for reporting only and never enters capacity.

cases.input: Europe/Athens fall-back day 2026-10-25 on which local 03:00-03:59 occurs twice, first at offset +03:00 then at offset +02:00, with tzdbRelease pinned.
cases.expect: The day resolves to 25 exact hours with both occurrences distinguished by offset; the nominal working day from the contractual pattern is unchanged and plannedAvailability does not grow.

cases.input: Europe/Athens spring-forward day 2026-03-29 on which local 03:00-03:59 does not exist.
cases.expect: The day resolves to 23 exact hours; the week still yields five nominal working days and plannedAvailability neither shrinks nor inflates.

cases.input: On the spring-forward day the nominal working duration is rewritten to 7 hours to match the 23 exact clock hours of the day.
cases.expect: The rewrite is rejected; nominal duration is never derived from or replaced by exact elapsed duration.

cases.input: An AvailabilityProjection run declares runId, computedAt, tzdbRelease, calendarRuleSetRelease, organizationalScopeRef, periodRef, patternRef, absenceSetDigest, allocationSetDigest and policyRef.
cases.expect: The projection is publishable as derived, non-master output addressed by runId.

cases.input: An AvailabilityProjection is published with no tzdbRelease and no calendarRuleSetRelease in its manifest.
cases.expect: Publication is rejected; an incomplete manifest is not publishable.

cases.input: A computed availability window is stored as a mastered attribute of the person and later read as authoritative without a run manifest.
cases.expect: The mastership is rejected; availability is derived and resolvable only as an identified run.

cases.input: The profile adds a constraint that narrows a WM-ACT-008 scheduling component and treats WM-ACT-008 as a profiled base.
cases.expect: The constraint is rejected; WM-ACT-008 is reference-only and is never profiled, constrained or extended.

cases.input: A dated scheduled commitment held in WM-ACT-008 is cited by the availability projection as planned intent.
cases.expect: The citation resolves as a reference; the commitment does not master pattern, absence, allocation or availability, and the projection still derives from pattern, calendar, absence and allocation only.
